displayName: Warcraft III map encoder from UVW
limitations: Accepts UVW bytes and returns one .w3x: the HM3W header and an MPQ with war3map.w3e, war3map.w3i, war3map.doo and war3mapUnits.doo. The first space's heightfield and cliff levels become the W3E corners (ADR-WORLD-003 read backwards); a world in warcraft3-world-unit writes back its own heights, another world is written one grid cell to one 128-unit cell.

Ground tiles come from terrain materials named tile-<tileset> (16 at most), the heaviest weight of a corner wins; a tile-blight corner is blighted over the default tile; objects with a four-character game type become doodads or units, start points sloc start locations with one player slot each.

Water, regions, cameras, objects without a game type and other spaces are not written, each loss reported; no map script, pathing or shadow map is written, so the World Editor must save the map before the game runs it.
